about.full:
Hi, I'm **Brian Dicky Vanka Andaraneva** — a Fullstack Web Developer based in Sidoarjo, East Java.

Fifth-semester Informatics undergraduate at **UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur** with over 1.5 years of hands-on, project-based experience in fullstack web development. Proficient in backend engineering with **PHP and Laravel**, modern frontend development with **React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS**, and artificial intelligence API integration (**Google Gemini AI**).

Currently working as a Fullstack Developer at **Javatekno Mitra Solusi**, building the **PUSATKOS** web platform in Laravel 12 and MySQL with structured MVC architecture and multi-role user workflows (public visitors, kos owners, and customers). Committed to delivering clean code architecture, optimal performance, and intuitive user experiences.

projects.title: PUSATKOS
projects.description: Built an integrated boarding house (kos) discovery and rental management web application based on Laravel 12 and PHP 8.2. Engineered for three core user roles: public visitors exploring and searching featured kos recommendations, kos owners managing property listings (CRUD), reviews, statistics, and notifications through a dedicated dashboard, and customers/members managing room bookings, digital invoices, and profiles. Implemented modular MVC architecture, role-based routing, and MySQL database integration.

projects.title: Tanggapin
projects.description: Built an integrated school operational and management platform designed to connect student data, early warning risk detection, case workflows, parent communication, and payment tracking into a structured decision-making ecosystem. Features multi-role access (Super Admin, Principal, BK Counselor, Homeroom Teacher, Cashier, Parents), automated academic & attendance risk alerts, incident response checklists, and BOS financial validation.

projects.title: OLARA
projects.description: Developed a smart circular waste management and eco-wellness platform integrating AI-powered waste scanning, on-demand doorstep pickup logistics, drop-off bank directory, circular raw material marketplace, and instant e-wallet rewards. Features an AI scanner for automated recyclable material detection with real-time market value estimation, fleet scheduling (Eco Bike, Tosa, Van Box), Midtrans Snap payment integration, eco-points wallet, and carbon footprint reduction analytics.

projects.title: Vehicle Tax
projects.description: Built a desktop application implementing object-oriented PKB and SWDKLLJ tax calculation with owner and vehicle data management, using Java Swing and C++ Qt. Implemented automatic tax calculation with result breakdown, transaction history, and search, edit, and delete functionality, with file-based persistence on the Qt version.

projects.title: SIPEMMA
projects.description: Built an integrated modern Point of Sale (POS) and restaurant operations web application powered by Laravel 13, PHP 8.3+, and Tailwind CSS v4 + Flowbite. Features an interactive cashier workflow with real-time cart, Dine In (table selection) & Take Away order support, automatic 10% PB1 tax calculation, digital receipt printing, full menu CRUD with automatic inventory tracking, operational & sales KPI analytics dashboard, and an AI smart assistant powered by Google Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash) for culinary business analytics and promotional strategies.

projects.title: Nalar
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered personalized learning companion web application designed to help university students master academic subjects deeply. Built with Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features a modern landing page and interactive study workspace that extracts lecture PDFs, identifies conceptual comprehension weaknesses, and delivers adaptive private-tutor guidance.

description: Developing the PUSATKOS web application using Laravel 12 and PHP 8.2, handling both responsive frontend Blade/Bootstrap views and backend MVC architecture.

Engineered complete workflows for 3 core roles: Public visitors (search, filter & featured recommendations), Kos Owners (property listing CRUD, analytics dashboard, reviews, statistics, notifications), and Customers/Members (booking flow, digital invoices, and profile management).
Structured modular MVC layers (controllers, Eloquent models, Blade views), role-based routing systems, and MySQL relational database integration.
Participating in an industry-oriented, project-based learning program focused on full-stack web development and AI integration.
Developing skills across frontend, backend, React, JavaScript, AI, and web application development through structured learning and hands-on projects.
